Question Choices: Select which fraction is smaller? 2/5 or 2/7 : 2/5 2/7
Hints: The numerators are the same. Think about how many pieces the whole is split into.
Solution: 2/7   -> The numerators are the same, so both fractions show 2 pieces. Now look at the denominators. The denominator tells how many equal pieces the whole is divided into. A whole divided into 7 pieces makes smaller pieces than a whole divided into 5 pieces. So each piece in 2/7 is smaller than each piece in 2/5, which means 2/7 < 2/5.
